note: the output matrix (lm_head) made by tools/convert/yskn_convert.py, symbol by symbol against the released one. 'statistic_of_the_original_model': the statistic this program takes (the output of the final norm of the original model on the 192 calibration windows). 'statistic_of_the_released_one': the statistic the released output matrix was made with on 2026-10-08 (the output of the final norm behind an earlier conversion in which every matrix had 3 bits, 128 WikiText windows; not published), given with --head-stat. 'error' is tr(D H D^T) / tr(W H W^T) under the statistic used.
